description: 1 negative : glass ; 4 x 5 in. or smaller | Photograph shows Benjamin Fink, half-length portrait, standing, facing front, holding Tiger, referred to as "Tige", the White House cat with President Calvin Coolidge.

notes: Caption from similar photograph: Benj. Fink, guard at the Navy Dept. found Tige promenading around the Navy Bldg. and immediately returned him to the White House. Tige's disappearance was broadcasted by Wash. radio stations. (Source: album: 1 March to 30 April 1924, v. 2, Herbert E. French, National Photo Company, p. 25, no. 29633)
